explication: Meeting Calendar is a WordPress plugin for managing recurring meetings and presenting their occurrences as a calendar or timetable. The principal flow is meeting authoring and storage, server-side occurrence generation and REST retrieval, then rendering the returned meeting data in an interactive frontend. Separate capabilities include administrative date previews and cancellation controls, team filtering, calendar/list views, and ICS feeds. Backend excerpts are partial and REST/ICS internals were not sampled, so those branches are shown only where plugin wiring or README documentation supports them.
